content.short: PropBase is a RWA marketplace on Aptos that fractionalizes high-quality real estate for global institutional access.
content.description: PropBase is a leading decentralized platform for tokenized real-world assets (RWAs), specifically designed to democratize access to high-quality real estate investments. Built natively on the Aptos blockchain, the protocol allows users to invest in fractionalized property assets starting from as little as $100. By converting illiquid physical properties into liquid digital tokens ($PROPS), PropBase enables participants to earn monthly rental yields and benefit from potential capital appreciation. The platform focuses on professional asset management and regulatory alignment for investors.
content.meta: PropBase offers fractionalized real estate tokenization and rental yield tools on Aptos. Discover PropBase and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
